name: mauritius-vat
description: Mauritius VAT for 2026. Use to prepare, review or classify transactions for a Mauritius VAT return, Form VAT 3. Covers the 15 percent rate, the Rs 3 million registration threshold, monthly and quarterly periods, zero-rated and exempt supplies, the Rs 10 million monthly limit, reverse charge, blocked input tax, partial exemption, repayment, foreign digital suppliers, visitor refunds, freeport supplies, e-invoicing and Finance Act 2026 changes. Always read before handling Mauritius VAT work, MRA VAT returns or VAT registration questions.
